headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 4 AM EST THURSDAY THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING

periods.name: Rest of tonight
periods.text: Northeast winds 15 to 20 knots becoming north. Rain, then a chance of rain late. Waves 2 to 4 feet building to 3 to 5 feet late.

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots increasing to 30 knots. A chance of rain in the morning, then rain likely in the afternoon. Waves 3 to 5 feet building to 3 to 6 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

periods.name: Thursday night
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots. A chance of rain. Waves 3 to 6 feet subsiding to 2 to 4 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots becoming northwest 10 to 15 knots. Rain in the morning, then a chance of rain in the afternoon. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Saturday through Monday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 54 degrees, off Cleveland 58 degrees, and off Erie 56 degrees.
